name: m4-pr212-guards-typer
description: Does [retronym/scala#212](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/212) cost the batch typer anything? It gathers the scratch state of type operations into `SymbolTable#Scratch`, runs each completion in its own `Frame` of recursion guards, encodes the lub/glb tables as `MemoGuard`, and (last commit) encodes the subtype, base type and volatile guards as `RecursionGuard` / `SubTypeGuard`. The PR's TODO: drop the last commit if it costs anything on `isSubType`.

`memo` vs `tip` isolates that last commit; `aa` is a second build of `base`, the noise floor. re2s and scalap stopped after the typer, so the change is not diluted by the backend. Release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap. Builds alternate fork by fork over 5 rounds. Compare within this campaign only.

variantDescriptions.aa: the same commit as `base`, for the noise floor
variantDescriptions.memo: the PR's first two commits, at `22c84f86cf`: `Scratch`, frames per completion, `MemoGuard`
